items.item_text: Current BLS required (must be certified through the American Heart Association)

Minimum Qualifications: High school diploma (or equivalent) required Possesses a Certificate to practice as a Medical Assistant (MA Diploma or Certificate from accredited program required) Has the ability to read, write and speak English in order to perform duties of the position Current BLS required (must be certified through the American Heart Association)
Possesses a Certificate to practice as a Medical Assistant (MA Diploma or Certificate from accredited program required)
Obtain all required information for the provider prior to the patient's appointment
Prepare the patient prior to the provider entering the treatment room.

Keep accurate documentation in the patient's chart pertaining to the appointment or any interaction with a patient within her/his scope of service, (i.e., daily chart preparation for visit, medication refills or response to written order given by the provider or phone messages).
Interview individuals and obtain comprehensive and accurate information, prioritize incoming telephone calls appropriately.
Communicate effectively in oral and written form.
Communicates effectively with all members of the health care team.
Has the ability to read, write and speak English in order to perform duties of the position
